crossRefs.note: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
Ascribe to Yahweh, you relatives of the peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength!
Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.
He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.
Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and…
Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that…
But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don’t desire…

translations.web: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
translations.kjv: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
translations.asv: I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in Jehovah.
